'''''Tuana''''' was a [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] which carried [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] who had acquired valuable information concerning the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]]. ''Tuana'', along with a group of other civilian vessels, some of which contained [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] was held up by the [[Emancipator|''Accuser'']], which also bought the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] [[Grappler (Immobilizer 418 cruiser)|''Grappler'']] to prevent it from leaving. When the Interdictor was driven out by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] in [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and [[A-wing]]s all of the ships, as well as the transport made a run for their hyperspace junctions but were opened fired on by the ''Accuser''. It is likely that the ''Tuana'' made it back to the Rebels.
